entry.title: PQC output type discussion
entry.summary: The recent discussion inadvertently shifted from its original focus on Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) output types to the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act (CISA). Although the overview provided was appreciated, the segue into CISA topics suggests a potential need for creating a separate thread to maintain clarity and organization in discussions. This separation would help in keeping the original topic of PQC outputs intact while adequately addressing the complexities and details related to CISA without overlap. Forming a new topic specifically for CISA could facilitate more focused and productive discussions among participants interested in cybersecurity information sharing policies.
